GOT QUESTIONS?

🇬🇧 Study in UK FAQs

Everything you need to know about studying in the UK — admissions, fees, work visas, IELTS waivers, and living expenses.

Interactive UK Student FAQ Desk
Select any question to expand
Q1 Why study in the United Kingdom?
The UK hosts 4 of the world's top 10 universities (QS World Rankings). Degrees are typically shorter (3 years for Bachelor's, 1 year for Master's), saving time and money while providing 2 year post study work visa rights under the Graduate Route.
Q2 What is the UK Graduate Route (PSW Visa)?
The Graduate Route permits international students who complete an undergraduate or postgraduate degree in the UK to stay and work (or look for work) for 2 years (3 years for PhD graduates) without requiring an employer visa sponsorship.
Q3 Can I study in the UK without IELTS?
Yes! Many UK universities accept 70%+ in Class 12 English, Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificates, or alternative tests like PTE Academic, TOEFL iBT, and Duolingo. DreamSky counselors guide you through IELTS waiver options.
Q4 How much does it cost to study in the UK?
Tuition fees range from £13,000 to £24,000 per year depending on university and program. Living expenses required by UK Visas & Immigration (UKVI) are £1,334/month for London and £1,023/month outside London.
Q5 What are international student work rights?
Degree level Student Visa holders can work up to 20 hours per week during term time and full time (40 hours/week) during official university vacation periods.
Q6 What is CAS & visa processing time?
CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) is an official reference number issued by your UK university once offer conditions and deposit are met. Student visa decision times are usually 3 to 4 weeks.
Q7 Are scholarships available for UK universities?
Yes! Most UK universities offer automatic merit bursaries ranging from £1,000 to £5,000. Prestige scholarships like Chevening and Commonwealth offer up to 100% full funding for eligible applicants.
Q8 How does DreamSky assist with UK applications?
DreamSky provides 100% free expert counseling: profile assessment, UCAS application filling, SOP writing support, CAS interview preparation, UKVI visa documentation, and pre departure briefings.
